method: Deterministic cosine similarity over shared skill axes. Description mentions use heuristic 6/7 targets; category fallback uses disclosed 5 targets. Company/category joins use supplied IDs.

excluded_sources.clean_data.parquet: 1,415,533 rows but inspected samples contain skill/benefit fragments in title/description, no role IDs, salary, employer or location. Held out rather than represented as reliable job listings.
excluded_sources.employee_income.csv: 50 age/experience/income rows without currency, pay period, role or location. Not suitable for role-based salary prediction; age is not used in matching.
excluded_sources.linkdin_Job_data.xlsx: Duplicate-format source of the supplied LinkedIn CSV; not double-counted.
excluded_sources.job_industries.csv: Industry ID lookup not supplied. Company industry labels used where a company ID joins.
excluded_sources.company_specialities.csv: Employer specialties do not prove requirements of an individual role.
excluded_sources.employee_counts.csv: Company size is not an individual skill requirement.
excluded_sources.Largest_Companies.csv: No compatible company ID join; not used to invent company names.
excluded_sources.skill_taxonomy.json: Original technology-heavy extraction counts are not proficiency labels. Demand counts recomputed from the prepared corpus.
